name: THE GUN WORKS
line: Weight, recoil, and a head that respects it. Nobody needed the pitch document.

name: THE TRILOGY OF CARE
line: Three separate systems asking the player to sit with it. The industry stands and does not sit back down.

name: TOTAL PURPLE
line: A numbered mannequin in a grape skybox. The brand guide has achieved sentience.

name: THE PARKING LOT DOCTRINE
line: An ordinary man does an extraordinary amount of damage over a space marked 4B.

name: AN ACTUAL VIDEO GAME
line: Three combat features in one box. Somebody in this building still remembers what these are for.

name: IT JUST WORKS
line: Sixty frames and a HUD you can read. Reviewers will not mention it and everyone will feel it.

name: THE ENGINE OF THESEUS
line: Rebuilt from the mount points out. Nothing to show the board. Everything to show the player.

name: ONE GOOD NIGHT
line: Strip lights, a wet floor, two people talking about nothing. This is the whole medium in ninety seconds.

name: A MAN AND HIS DOG
line: Mark is late, Mark is balding, and Mark is not leaving without the dog. Pre-orders have doubled again.

name: THE ROOM WITH THE DOOR CLOSED
line: Nobody gave notes and the thing actually ends. Two miracles in one box.

name: THE CLIP FARM
line: A man folds into a shopping trolley and stays there. The compilation has four million views by Thursday.

name: SOFA SUMMER
line: Two controllers, one sofa, and track four playing over the whole holiday.

name: THE HONEST STOREFRONT
line: No target render and a programmer swearing in the Discord at midnight. Nobody has seen this before and nobody knows what to do.

name: THE LOT REMEMBERS
line: Walk back past the roundabout an hour later and the decals are still there, spelling out your afternoon.

name: HE ASKED NICELY
line: He talks about his boiler for ninety seconds and then he drops the weapon. The room goes very quiet.

name: DIFFICULTY IS THE POINT
line: It can kill you and you can slide out of the way. That is a whole genre, right there, in two cards.

name: TREATED LIKE AN ADULT
line: No glowing paint, no marker, and something behind a wall nobody was told about. Eleven days to find it.

name: THE SHOTGUN COVENANT
line: One barrel, one decision, and a parking space that will need repainting.

name: MOD ETERNAL
line: Every enemy is now a screaming version of your mascot. You are on the front page again and you did nothing.

name: GOVERNANCE ALL THE WAY DOWN
line: The final boss is a committee and the combat was approved by a different committee. The circle is closed.

name: THE FULL PURPLE
line: Two separate processes now exist to approve the thing that has not been made yet.

name: WALLET-FIRST DESIGN
line: Three separate storefronts inside the thing they already paid for. Revenue per user has never looked better.

name: THE TREADMILL
line: A place, a calendar, and a reason to log in on Tuesday forever. The engagement graph has a pulse.

name: PAY TO BE EARLY
line: The best sword is a pre-order and the missing chapter is on the disc. The community found the files.

name: THE STUTTER TAX
line: It phones home and it checks your papers. In the market square it does both at once and drops to nine frames.

name: GRAPE SODA MASSACRE
line: The blood is ultraviolet because the brand guide has no exceptions. It looks like a soft drink advert and the internet has noticed.

name: THE PACIFIST WITH A SHOTGUN
line: Mandatory dialogue resolution, plus a weapon that ends dialogue. The enemy AI has stopped responding to both.

name: THE CONTRADICTION
line: Combat was removed and the gunfeel was retained. There is now a beautifully tuned weapon with nothing to point it at.

name: THE DECORATIVE HEALTH BAR
line: The boss deals zero damage and also has a real damage number. QA has filed this eleven times.

name: THE DAMP BLACKSMITH
line: Ninety seconds of hand-written boiler talk, then six minutes of a machine offering the player a therapist.

name: THE INVESTOR SAID THE WORD
line: The devs are in the Discord on the night the chain announcement lands. Nobody should have to do that.

name: HONESTLY, A LOOTBOX
line: The trailer was actual gameplay and the actual gameplay opens a box for money. Both things are true and only one of them survives the thread.

name: THE DOOR LEFT AJAR
line: It ends cleanly and then a rectangle appears that says 'and more.' You can hear the room deflate.

name: FORTY GAITS, ELEVEN FRAMES
line: Every walk cycle is unique and the frame budget was not consulted. The market square is a slideshow with excellent posture.

name: FOUR SCREENS BEFORE THE LOGO
line: An advisory about an advisory, then a paragraph about the earth, then a spinning logo. The player has not moved yet.

name: FORTY DEFINITIONS, NO RELOAD BUTTON
line: It refuses to explain how to play and provides a searchable index of what it means by 'harm.'

name: THE WHOLE COSTUME
line: Four separate systems for how the characters look, each with its own edge cases. The wardrobe is now a subsystem and it is the buggiest thing in the build.

name: THE APPARATUS
line: A council, a spreadsheet and a pass on the pass. Every decision now takes four weeks and arrives with a document attached.

name: AFRAID OF ITSELF
line: It warns you, it apologises, and then it declines to do the thing. Four separate features exist to stop the game happening to you.

name: THE PLAN WAS THE FIGHT
line: You picked the fight and then refused to end it. The wishlist graph has never looked like this and neither has your inbox.

name: SHELF PLACEMENT
line: Front page, sale week, filed next to the lighthouse game. Enormous reach at a price you did not choose.
